steps.title: Define Project Architecture & Meta
steps.description: Initialize app-meta and API schema specifications for ZenithNotes.

steps.title: Build Semantic HTML5 App Shell
steps.description: Create responsive layout including sidebar navigation, search, note feed, note editor modal, and auth modals.

steps.title: Configure Tailwind Browser Runtime & Custom Typography
steps.description: Establish theme styling, custom scrollbars, transitions, and clean note color accents.

steps.title: Implement Generic API & Auth Client
steps.description: Create client handler for register, login, logout, and OTP password recovery against TrumpleDroid API.

steps.title: Develop Local Deterministic Calculators
steps.description: Implement local calculators for word counts, character counts, reading duration, and category aggregates.

steps.title: CRUD Operations for Notes
steps.description: Integrate create, read, update, and delete calls targeting the generic /data endpoint with fallback guest storage.

steps.title: Filtering, Search & Pinning Logic
steps.description: Implement dynamic real-time text query filtering, tag grouping, and pinned note organization.

steps.title: Interactive Note Editor & Tagging
steps.description: Build modern editor modal supporting color presets, tags, checklists, and auto-computed live metrics.

steps.title: Password Reset OTP Modal Flow
steps.description: Integrate two-step OTP verification and password reset matching backend specifications.

steps.title: Building zenithnotes
steps.description: Finalize UI wiring, state synchronizations, accessibility checks, and performance tests.
